***
`DirectSum ι β` is the direct sum of a family of additive commutative monoids `β i`.

Note: `open DirectSum` will enable the notation `⨁ i, β i` for `DirectSum ι β`.

***
`a ≠ b`, or `Ne a b` is defined as `¬ (a = b)` or `a = b → False`,
and asserts that `a` and `b` are not equal.

```lean
finsuppLEquivDirectSum.{u, v, u_1} (R : Type u) (M : Type v) [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] (ι : Type u_1)
  [DecidableEq ι] : (ι →₀ M) ≃ₗ[R] ⨁ (x : ι), M
```

copies of M indexed by ι.
